# Skirmish AI scenario test catalog

This index joins the [manifest](../../../../../../../../../../tools/ai/fixtures/skirmish-v1.json) to the linked requirement documents, fixtures, and test files. It is navigation, not a second source of truth.

**Registered is not passed:** no row below claims execution evidence. A spec link means the file mentions the ID; the matrix must still execute an ID-specific semantic assertion.

- 121 required scenarios; 111/111 pure fixtures registered; 93/120 real-game recipes registered; 4 runtime cases deferred for absent island-map content.
- 23 additional native recipe specifications authored, not executable or executed. Their setup, actions, assertions and missing bindings are explicit; registered and passed counts are unchanged.
- Pure cases use Jest without a map. Browser cases use the [Playwright driver](../../../../../../../../../../apps/portal-e2e/src/e2e/skirmish-ai-runtime.spec.ts) and launch a real lobby/Phaser match with authoritative outcomes.
- Current registered browser recipes still name mutable shipped maps. Their migration to [frozen test maps](test-map-contract.md) is planned, not complete. Keep natural-map playtests separate from deterministic CI.
- For each scenario, its linked requirement defines the setup/trigger and expected outcome. The linked JSON defines current variants, seeds, maps, checkpoints, and predicates. A missing setup or recipe is work to author, not permission to infer a pass.
- Update the requirement row and manifest/fixture, then regenerate with `node tools/ai/generate-skirmish-test-catalog.mjs --write`. CI checks that this file matches its sources; do not edit generated rows by hand.
